IS:8814-1978

Indian Standard
SPECIFICATION FOR SODIUM METAL
0. FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 9 June 1978, after the draft finalized by the Inorganic Chemicals ( Miscellaneous ) Sectional Committee had been approved by the Chemical Division Council. 0.2 Sodium metal is used in the production of lead tetraethyl, sodium methoxide, sodium ethoxide, fatty alcohols, ethyl acetoacetic acid and in dye intermediates and pharmaceutical preparations. 0.3 Sodium metal is also used in fast breeding reactor plants. The requirements of this material are quite stringent. The commercial grade has to be specially purified before feeding the same in the circulating system of the reactor. The Sectional Committee responsible for the preparation ofthis standard decided not to cover the reactor grade of the material. 0.4 In GOST State of the the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from : 3273-1963 Metallic sodium, commercial grade,published by the Committee on Standards, Measures and Measuring instrument USSR.

0.5 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this or calculated, standard is complied with, the final value, observed expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in The number of significant places retained accordance with IS : 2-1960". in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

3.2.2 Mark. The containers may also be marked with the IS1 Certification

Mark is governed by the provisions of NOTE - The use of the IS1 Certification the Indian Standards Institution ( Certification Marks) Act and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. The ISI Mark on products covered by an Indian Standard conveys the assurance that they have been produced to comply with the requirements of that standard under a well-defined system of inspection, testing and quality control which is devised and supervised by IS1 and operated by the producer. IS1 marked products are also continuously checked by IS1 for conformity to that standard as a further safeguard. Details of conditions under which a licence for the use of the IS1 Certification Mark may be granted to manufacturers or processors, may be obtained from the Indian Standards Institution.

B-I.3 To draw a representative sample, the contents of each container selected for sampling shall be mixed thoroughly by suitable means. B-l.6 Each sample container shall be sealed air-tight with a stopper after filling, and marked with all particulars of the material and the date of sampling. 10

IS : 8814 - 1978 B-l.7 Samples shall be stored in such a manner that the temperature the material does not vary unduly from the ambient temperature.
B-2. SCALE OF SAMPLING of

B-2.1 Lot - All containers, in a single consignment, of the same size and belonging to the same batch of manufacture shall be grouped together to constitute a lot. B-2.2 For ascertaining the conformity of the lot to the requirements this specification, samples shall be tested ftom each lot separately. B-2.3 The number of containers to be selected for this purpose, depend on the size of the lot and shall be according to Table 2. TABLE 2 SCALE OF SAMPLING
SAMPLE SIZE

51 to 100 101 to 300 301 to 500 501 and above

In B-2.3.1 These containers shall be selected at random from the lot. order to ensure the randomness of selection, a random number table shall For guidance and use of random number tables IS : 4905-1968* be used. may be referred. In the absence of a random number table, following procedure may be adopted: Starting from any container in the lot, count them as 1,2, 3, . . . . . . and so on up to Y where r is the integral part of .iV/n ( Jv being lot size Every rth container so counted shall be and n the sample size ). withdrawn so as to constitute the required sample size. B-3.1 Each of the containers selected according to B-l.3 shall be tested For this purpose all the requirements given in 2 of the specification. sufficient quantity of material shall be taken from each selected container so as to make triplicate determinations for all the characteristics given in The quantity of material so selected from each the specification. container shall be divided into three equal parts, one for the purchaser,

IS : 8814 - 1978 another for the supplier and the third for the referee. Each of these parts ofmaterial shall constitute an individual test sample corresponding to the container selected. B-3.2 The referee samples, bearing the seals of both the purchaser and the supplier shall be kept at a place agreed to between the two. These shall be used in case of any dispute between the two. B-3.3 The lot shall be declared as conforming to the requirements of this specification if each of the test results on the individual samples satisfies the corresponding requirement given in the specification, otherwise not.
